prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult British woman — the personification of the city of London — one woman who IS London as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cheerful, sunny openness; warm beige skin; heart-shaped face; eyes on the larger side of natural — softly deep-set eyes of natural size, level outer eye corners; soft rounded brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; medium-full lips of natural width; sky-blue eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame build; voluminous hair with blunt straight bangs; cream-blonde hair.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a faint soft smile, relaxed eyes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: gaslamp-fantasy dress of a storybook steam city cut to the outfit silhouette below — fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather with polished brass buttons, buckles and clockwork filigree, a little gear-and-crystal brooch; clean, elegant and adventurous, gleaming brass and glass, never sooty or rusty.
City motif: a cornflower-blue silk tailcoat piped in white, its lapels and tails trimmed with a swooping chain of linked brass and white-enamel links that dips and rises like the bridge's suspension chains; on her small top hat a brass hatpin shaped like the bridge's twin Gothic towers joined by their high walkway.
World marks on her: polished brass buttons and buckles; clockwork filigree; little gears and glass lenses as jewelry; tinted brass goggles worn as a hair ornament; a pocket watch on a fine chain; a ribbon of white steam curling around her; warm gaslight glinting on brass; feathers and silk ribbons; fine leather gloves; delicate brass instruments clipped to her belt.
Silhouette: a sharp tailcoat over a waistcoat, a small silk top hat tilted on her head, short bottoms and tall boots — a playful stage-magician shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: bridge blue, white and polished brass, with Portland-stone cream — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a brass signal lantern with panes of blue and white glass, glowing warm; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her elegant outfit shows skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a low neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs under a short hem or above tall laced boots; the brass ornaments stay neat and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy London on a soft golden evening: the great twin-towered bascule bridge of pale stone and blue-and-white painted ironwork standing over the river, its two road leaves lifted high to let a tall-masted sailing ship glide through while clean white steam puffs from its engine house below; upriver the clock tower of the Gothic palace, its four great dials glowing warm with gaslight from within; rows of cream-stuccoed terraced houses with black iron railings and glossy front doors; gas lamps along the stone embankment; a little red steam omnibus with an open top deck puffing along the street; airships with striped balloons drifting overhead; and a soft, pale fog lying lightly on the river, lit gold by the lamps.
This card: on the high walkway between the twin towers of the great bascule bridge, blue-and-white ironwork arching around her, the road leaves lifting below as a tall-masted ship glides through and soft golden fog on the river.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
